notes.title: Aircar update is officially live!
notes.content:
The new Aircar update is officially live on Steam VR! This update refreshes the original experience for the new wave of VR headsets. The update adds vertical takeoff and landing, landing pads, visual improvements and bug fixes. You will need to explore the city and surrounding area to find all 8 landing pads! Let me know if you have any problems.

I also created a cinematic trailer to go with the update 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7O1N9eEPezE

notes.title: Aircar is coming to Steam VR in August!
notes.content:
Aircar is turning two and coming to Steam VR with an update!

This update refreshes the original experience for the new wave of VR headsets. This update brings Aircar to Steam VR and adds vertical takeoff and landing, landing pads, visual improvements and bug fixes. 

Aircar will be available free to play on Steam VR in early August 2019. 
8 landing pads have been added to the city. You will need to explore the city and surrounding area to find all 8 landing pads. Landing pads bring the addition of vertical movement controls. Stay tuned for an exact release date and full update notes!

If you would like to test the update on Steam VR, please message me and I can give you a Key!
